root_cause: Missing/silent tool-call pattern (NOT a missing-tool-config issue). put_account_on_test IS in root_agent's tools[] and the On_Test_Flow instruction explicitly directs the agent to call it, but the LLM non-deterministically narrates the success ('The Dallas branch account ending in 345 is now on test for one hour.') in the SAME turn it calls verify_passcode, WITHOUT ever calling put_account_on_test. In runs 1 and 2 (failed) the trace shows verify_passcode -> success narration with no put_account_on_test call; in run 3 (passed) the agent correctly chains verify_passcode -> put_account_on_test -> narration. The Put_On_Test step's example confirmation phrase in instruction.txt ('...is now on test for one hour.') lets the model emit the canned success line without executing the action. This is the agent side, confirmed by the golden uc2_on_test_disambiguation_sms_happy_path failing 0/3 with the identical TOOL_MISSING put_account_on_test symptom. Walked sim-specific order: (1) sim user behavior is correct (user clearly requests on-test for one hour, then declines SMS); (2) sim config is correct (the expectation 'must call a tool to put the Dallas branch on test' is a legitimate, non-stale contract that run 3 satisfies); (3) therefore agent-side. The proximate cause is the LLM collapsing the verify+act+narrate sequence and dropping the tool call.

decision_tree_path: Is this sim user behavior? -> no (user request is clear and correct)
Is this sim config (stale/too-narrow expectation)? -> no (expectation is valid; run 3 meets it)
Is the tool missing from the agent's tool list? -> no (put_account_on_test is in tools[])
Are instructions contradictory? -> no (instruction correctly orders the call)
Is the behavior non-deterministic (silent/missing tool call)? -> yes (1/3 sim, 0/3 golden; verify+narrate collapsed, tool call dropped)
fix_summary_one_line: Enforce put_account_on_test via a trigger/guard pattern (after_model_callback) so the agent cannot emit the on-test success narration without first calling the tool; secondarily, soften the canned success example phrase in the Put_On_Test instruction step so it no longer invites narration before execution.
notes: eval_pass_rates routing: declines_sms_after_on_test is 1/3 (intermediate) -> flaky-class, but the companion golden uc2_on_test_disambiguation_sms_happy_path is 0/3 with the same symptom, so this is a real, reproducible silent-tool-call bug rather than pure noise. The deterministic remedy is the callback trigger pattern (the project already uses an after_model_callback for the analogous silent-end_session problem at the same path), which is why suggested_fix_type is callback_edit rather than flaky. Do NOT add put_account_on_test to tools[] -- it is already present.
